snippet.title: PC Cafe Simulator - Early Access October 28 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Build and manage your very own PC cafe in **PC Cafe Simulator**!

Start with a small PC cafe and grow your business by purchasing new computers, expanding your space, serving food and drinks, decorating the cafe, hiring staff, and dealing with troublesome customers.

Play solo or team up with friends in co-op multiplayer with up to 8 players.

**PC Cafe Simulator enters Steam Early Access on October 28, 2026.**

Add PC Cafe Simulator to your Steam Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375990

Features:
• Build and manage your own PC cafe
• Purchase and upgrade gaming PCs and equipment
• Expand and customize your cafe
• Cook and serve food and drinks
• Hire employees to help run the business
• Deal with various customers and unexpected situations
• Play solo or co-op with up to 8 players

Wishlist now and get ready to open your own PC cafe!

#PCCafeSimulator #Simulator #IndieGame #Steam #PCGaming #Coop
